method: Actual route bodies plus DTO/JSON serialization in fresh ORM sessions. Disposable SQLite fixtures, cProfile and tracemalloc enabled. No HTTP middleware/authentication/network. DBAPI rows fetched measured; internal database rows examined and Python rows considered not measured. Each fixture has three scans per service and one observation per finding. Default splits half findings into target service; all-target scenarios put all 100000 there. Many-group fixture has 5000 package/remediation groups before risk/state filters. Exceptions and overdue/resolved findings are present in state-filter fixture. Member fixture has 30 groups, including one with thousands of findings. SQLite query plans captured for representative CTE statements. Not PostgreSQL or production latency.

WITH members AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT findings.id AS id, findings.cve AS cve, findings.cve_normalized AS cve_normalized, findings.severity AS severity, findings.active AS active, findings.episode_started AS started, CASE WHEN (lower(findings.severity) = ?) THEN ? WHEN (lower(findings.severity) = ?) THEN ? WHEN (lower(findings.severity) = ?) THEN ? WHEN (lower(findings.severity) = ?) THEN ? WHEN (lower(findings.severity) = ?) THEN ? WHEN (lower(findings.severity) = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END AS rank, coalesce(finding_observations_1.simplified_key, ?) AS group_id, coalesce(finding_observations_1.simplified_package, ?) AS package, coalesce(finding_observations_1.simplified_remediation, ?) AS remediation, coalesce(finding_observations_1.simplified_fixed, ?) AS fixed, coalesce(finding_observations_1.simplified_package_sort, ?) AS package_sort, coalesce(finding_observations_1.simplified_fixed_sort, ?) AS fixed_sort 
FROM findings LEFT OUTER JOIN finding_observations AS finding_observations_1 ON finding_observations_1.id = coalesce((SELECT max(finding_observations.id) AS max_1 
FROM finding_observations 
WHERE finding_observations.finding_id = findings.id AND finding_observations.execution_id = ?), (SELECT max(finding_observations.id) AS max_2 
FROM finding_observations 
WHERE finding_observations.finding_id = findings.id)) 
WHERE findings.service_id = ? AND findings.active IS 1 AND findings.service_id = ? AND NOT (findings.service_id = ? AND (findings.service_id IN (?) AND lower(findings.severity) = ? AND findings.episode_started <= ? OR findings.service_id IN (?) AND lower(findings.severity) = ? AND findings.episode_started <= ? OR findings.service_id IN (?) AND lower(findings.severity) = ? AND findings.episode_started <= ? OR findings.service_id IN (?) AND lower(findings.severity) = ? AND findings.episode_started <= ? OR findings.service_id IN (?) AND ((lower(findings.severity) NOT IN (?, ?, ?, ?)) OR findings.severity IS NULL) AND findings.episode_started <= ?)) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT exceptions.id 
FROM exceptions 
WHERE exceptions.finding_id = findings.id AND exceptions.revoked_at IS NULL AND exceptions.starts_at <= ? AND exceptions.expires_at > ?))), 
groups AS 
(SELECT members.group_id AS group_id, min(members.package) AS package, min(members.remediation) AS remediation, min(members.package_sort) AS package_sort, min(members.id) AS first_id, count(distinct(nullif(members.cve_normalized, ?))) AS member_count, min(nullif(members.cve_normalized, ?)) AS representative_cve, min(CAST(? - members.rank AS VARCHAR) || ? || printf(?, members.id) || ? || members.severity) AS severity_key, min(CASE WHEN (members.active IS 1) THEN CAST(datetime(members.started, ? || CAST(CASE WHEN (lower(members.severity) = ?) THEN ? WHEN (lower(members.severity) = ?) THEN ? WHEN (lower(members.severity) = ?) THEN ? WHEN (lower(members.severity) = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END AS VARCHAR) || ?) AS VARCHAR) || substr(CAST(members.started AS VARCHAR), ?, ?) END) AS due 
FROM members GROUP BY members.group_id), 
fixed_groups AS 
(SELECT anon_1.group_id AS group_id, group_concat(anon_1.fixed, ?) AS fixed_version, group_concat(anon_1.fixed_sort, ?) AS fixed_sort 
FROM (SELECT anon_2.group_id AS group_id, anon_2.fixed AS fixed, anon_2.fixed_sort AS fixed_sort 
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT members.group_id AS group_id, members.fixed AS fixed, members.fixed_sort AS fixed_sort 
FROM members) AS anon_2 ORDER BY anon_2.group_id, anon_2.fixed) AS anon_1 GROUP BY anon_1.group_id), 
selected_groups AS 
(SELECT groups.group_id AS group_id, groups.package AS package, groups.remediation AS remediation, groups.package_sort AS package_sort, groups.first_id AS first_id, groups.member_count AS member_count, groups.representative_cve AS representative_cve, groups.severity_key AS severity_key, groups.due AS due, fixed_groups.fixed_sort AS fixed_sort, substr(fixed_groups.fixed_version, ?, ?) AS fixed_version, count(*) OVER () AS total_items 
FROM groups JOIN fixed_groups ON fixed_groups.group_id = groups.group_id ORDER BY groups.package_sort, fixed_groups.fixed_sort, groups.first_id
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?), 
representatives AS 
(SELECT members.group_id AS group_id, min(members.id) AS representative_id 
FROM members JOIN selected_groups ON selected_groups.group_id = members.group_id AND members.cve_normalized = selected_groups.representative_cve GROUP BY members.group_id), 
group_images AS 
(SELECT members.group_id AS group_id, count(distinct(finding_observations.image)) AS image_count 
FROM members JOIN selected_groups ON selected_groups.group_id = members.group_id JOIN finding_observations ON finding_observations.finding_id = members.id 
WHERE finding_observations.execution_id = ? AND finding_observations.image IS NOT NULL AND finding_observations.image != ? GROUP BY members.group_id)
 SELECT selected_groups.group_id, substr(selected_groups.package, ?, ?) AS package, substr(selected_groups.remediation, ?, ?) AS remediation, selected_groups.fixed_version, selected_groups.member_count, selected_groups.representative_cve, representatives.representative_id, selected_groups.severity_key, selected_groups.due, selected_groups.total_items, coalesce(group_images.image_count, ?) AS image_count 
FROM selected_groups LEFT OUTER JOIN representatives ON representatives.group_id = selected_groups.group_id LEFT OUTER JOIN group_images ON group_images.group_id = selected_groups.group_id ORDER BY selected_groups.package_sort, selected_groups.fixed_sort, selected_groups.first_id
